What Online Proctoring Solutions Do We Offer?
Audio Proctoring
Our Audio Proctoring feature improves assessment integrity by identifying external assistance and preventing illicit communication by capturing and recording any external audio source.
Deliver instant answers
Exam security is improved by forced full-screen mode, which stops test takers from using their devices to access other applications, websites, or resources. The chances of cheating are eliminated by preventing the candidate from looking up answers online or talking to other candidates during the test.
Manage your team
Logging tab change activity monitors a test-taker's browser behavior. An alert is sent out when our tool records instances when candidates switch away from the exam tab, potentially accessing unauthorized resources.
Disable External Copy/Paste
Prevent candidates from importing unauthorized and external information, thereby encouraging original results and grasping true skill assessment.
Whole Screen Recording
Get a comprehensive view of the candidate's test through whole screen recording. This feature captures every on-screen action, from cursor movements to application usage, creating a more accurate and high-quality recording of the entire assessment session.
Multi-Screen Detection
Multi-screen detection is a crucial feature that instantly alerts proctors if a test-taker attempts to use additional monitors or devices, effectively closing a common loophole in online exams by ensuring candidates stick to a single screen.
Limit for Permissible Violation
This admin feature sets a threshold for the number of times a test-taker can switch tabs or applications during an exam. Once this limit is exceeded, the system automatically terminates the test, preventing further opportunities for misconduct.
Email Watermarking
Whether you have a team of 2 or 200, our shared team inboxes keep everyone on the same page and in the loop.

What is Online Proctoring?
Online proctoring is a service that leverages technology to supervise exams conducted remotely, ensuring the integrity and authenticity of the examination process.
It allows candidates to take their exams from any location, eliminating the need for physical exam centers.
The process involves using webcams, microphones, and screen-sharing technology to monitor candidates in real-time. Additionally, advanced AI algorithms analyze candidate behavior to detect any irregularities or potential cheating attempts, ensuring a fair and secure testing environment.
What are the benefits of using online proctoring?
Online proctoring offers numerous benefits:
Flexibility
: Candidates can take exams from the comfort of their homes or any location with internet access, making it more convenient and reducing travel-related stress.
Security
: Enhanced security measures, including real-time monitoring and AI analysis, help maintain the integrity of the exam process by detecting and preventing cheating.
Cost-Effective
: Online proctoring eliminates the need for physical exam centers, reducing logistical costs and administrative overhead for institutions and organizations.
Scalability
: Institutions can easily scale their examination processes to accommodate a larger number of candidates without worrying about physical space limitations.
Environmental Impact
: By reducing the need for travel and printed materials, online proctoring contributes to a smaller carbon footprint and promotes sustainability.
How do you ensure the privacy of candidates during online proctoring?
We take candidate privacy very seriously. Our proctoring software is designed to comply with international privacy laws and regulations. All data collected during the exam, including video, audio, and screen recordings, is encrypted and stored securely.
We implement strict data access controls, ensuring that only authorized personnel can view the recordings. Additionally, our privacy policy clearly outlines how candidate data is collected, used, and stored, providing full transparency.
We also offer candidates the option to consent to data collection, ensuring they are fully informed about their rights and our practices.
What types of exams can be proctored online?
Our online proctoring software is versatile and can support a wide range of exams, including:
Academic Tests
: Standardized tests, midterms, finals, and other assessments for educational institutions.
Certification Exams
: Professional certification tests for industries such as IT, finance, healthcare, and more.
Corporate Assessments
: Pre-employment tests, skills assessments, and ongoing employee training evaluations.
Licensing Exams
: Exams required for obtaining licenses in various professions, such as real estate, law, and medical fields.
Admission Tests
: Entrance exams for colleges, universities, and specialized programs.
How do institutions review the results of online proctored exams?
After the exam, institutions can access detailed reports and recordings through our secure proctoring portal.
These reports include information on any flagged incidents, the candidate’s behavior during the exam, and the overall integrity of the exam session.
Authorized personnel can review the video, audio, and screen recordings to verify any suspicious activity and make informed decisions about the candidate’s performance.
The proctoring software also provides analytics and insights to help institutions understand trends and patterns in exam integrity.
